name: @chaoticgoodcomputing/tags-core
description: The tag system's shared logic for Quartz 5 plugins: the resolution rule, the shapes the cgc-tags engine publishes, their fileData types, a colour resolver for canvases, and a build-time check for colour values. See CONTEXT.md.
//exports: Source only: no build and no dist. The consuming plugin's build inlines it (ADR-0005). `./colour` is browser-only; `./colour-value` is server-only, and takes the host's lightningcss from the plugin that calls it.
//devDependencies: Types only. `vfile` is the module the fileData augmentation extends; a consuming plugin resolves its own copy, the host Quartz's.
